name: Red Saree Low Neck Blouse draped on hip

garment.name: Red sheer net saree with tonal floral embroidery, border, and deep-V sleeveless blouse
garment.subtype: sheer net saree with matching cropped blouse
garment.material: sheer red net or organza saree with tonal embroidery; blouse is opaque, smoother red fabric
garment.pattern: scattered small floral embroidery butis on the saree body, with a continuous embroidered border on the hem and pallu; blouse is solid red
construction: embroidered border along hem and pallu edge
garment.fit: fitted cropped blouse with a full, softly gathered saree skirt and a fluid sheer pallu
garment.length: floor-length saree; blouse ends just below the bust
details: pallu is distinctly sheerer than the gathered skirt
small floral motif visible on the front skirt
embroidered edge continues along the hem spread on the floor
skirt looks fuller and less transparent where pleated, consistent with layers over a red base

wearing_intents.name: Low-hip nivi drape with bare midriff and loose left-shoulder pallu
wearing_intents.description: The saree is wrapped low on the hips, not at the natural waist, with the front pleats tucked at hip level. A wide band of midriff is bare between the underbust blouse and the saree. The sheer pallu rests only on the left shoulder and hangs loosely down the back and left arm. The opposite shoulder has only the thin blouse strap. The floor-length skirt is full and, because of the kneeling pose, pools and spreads on the floor.
wearing_intents.waist_position: low on the hips, well below the natural waist
wearing_intents.garment_position: saree skirt wrapped and tucked at the hips; front pleats fall from the hip tuck; pallu over the left shoulder only; blouse stops just under the bust
wearing_intents.fit: body-skimming cropped blouse, full gathered skirt, loose sheer pallu
wearing_intents.silhouette: exposed midriff between a short fitted blouse and a low, full floor-length saree, with a sheer shoulder drape
wearing_intents.neckline_position: deep V open at center front; thin straps sit on the outer shoulders
wearing_intents.sleeve_position: sleeveless, no sleeve fabric on the arms
wearing_intents.tuck: front pleats tucked at the low hip rather than the natural waist
wearing_intents.drape: low nivi-style drape; pallu is not crossed over the torso and hangs free from the left shoulder
wearing_intents.layering: opaque cropped blouse worn with a sheer net saree; pallu layered only over the left shoulder
wearing_intents.fastening: pleats tucked into the low hip wrap; no visible pin holding the pallu across the chest
wearing_intents.exposure_intent: intentional wide bare midriff from underbust to low hips, open deep neckline, and an uncovered side at the low waist where a waist chain sits
preserve: preserve the saree sitting low on the hips
preserve the wide bare midriff between blouse and saree
preserve front pleats tucked at hip level
preserve the pallu on the left shoulder only
preserve the loose, sheer, uncrossed pallu
preserve the deep plunging V neckline
preserve thin spaghetti straps on the outer shoulders
preserve the cropped underbust blouse length
preserve the full gathered floor-length skirt
preserve tonal floral embroidery and the border
preserve the matching red blouse and saree as one set
preserve the metallic waist chain at the low hip
constraints: do not raise the saree to the natural waist
do not lengthen the blouse toward the waist
do not close or raise the deep V neckline
do not move the pallu to the other shoulder
do not wrap or pin the pallu across the chest
do not make the pallu opaque
do not change the full skirt into a narrow fitted drape
do not shorten the saree; floor pooling is from kneeling, not a short hem
do not remove the embroidery or border
accessories: stacked red bangles on the wrist
fine chain necklace with a small pendant
gold jhumka earrings with red drops
thin metallic waist chain sitting on the low hip

notes: Primary garment is the coordinated red saree and blouse; jewelry is part of the styling, not the garment.
Diyas, doorway, and room are not wardrobe properties.
Embroidery reads as tonal red on red; a separate metallic thread color is not clear enough to assert.
The hem spreads on the floor because the wearer is kneeling; the garment itself is floor length.
